author: Chris Cooley
name: CitySmash
tagline: Climb it. Smash it. Eat the snacks.
description: A giant cyber ape climbs and smashes his way across seven tabletop cities, day into night. Dress him in the garage, take on the rivals, play with friends on one screen or online.
controls: A / D walk · W / S climb · K jump (a jump at a wall grabs it)
Space / J punch (hold W or S: up or down) · L grab and eat
Player two: arrows · , punch · . jump · / grab · gamepads for three and four
